title: Invesco Launches the Invesco Stablecoin Reserves Onchain Fund, Bringing Invesco's Established Liquidity Management Onchain
summary: /PRNewswire/ -- Invesco Ltd. (NYSE: IVZ), a leading global asset management firm, today announced the launch of the Invesco Stablecoin Reserves Onchain Fund...
body_markdown:
*Actively managed money market fund combines Invesco's liquidity expertise with Superstate's leading onchain infrastructure for a GENIUS Act-compliant offering*


ATLANTA


, Nov. 17, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Invesco Ltd. (NYSE:IVZ ), a leading global asset management firm, today announced the launch of the Invesco Stablecoin


Reserves Onchain Fund (IROXX or the "Fund"), an actively managed vehicle compliant with the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins


(GENIUS) Act. Managed by Invesco's Global Liquidity Team and supported by Superstate Services LLC's (Superstate) tokenization


FundOS platform, IROXX invests in short-duration U.S. Treasury securities and other eligible reserve assets, bringing institutional quality reserve management into an onchain format. Investors including stablecoin


issuers and onchain infrastructure providers can hold those reserves in tokenized form with onchain verifiability, along with USDC access and compounding through daily reinvested dividends.


As stablecoins


are increasingly playing an integral role in the financial system, demand is growing to manage reserves in a transparent and regulated manner. The Fund is designed to serve as a reserve asset backing stablecoins


, combining a GENIUS Act-compliant investment strategy with an onchain structure that enables investors to hold verifiable reserve assets and transact using fiat or stablecoins


.


"We believe the acceleration of stablecoin


usage bringing more liquidity onchain will unlock a fly wheel effect to support the further adoption of tokenized fund offerings," said Kathleen Wrynn, Global Head of Digital Assets at Invesco. "The launch of the Invesco Stablecoin


Reserves Onchain Fund provides a GENIUS Act-compliant way for stablecoin


issuers to manage their reserves while earning yield. This is an important step in our long-term digital assets strategy, combining trusted investment management with blockchain-enabled capabilities."


IROXX is structured as a registered Rule 2a-7 government money market fund within the Invesco Short-Term Investments Trust. The Fund's investment objective is to provide current income consistent with preservation of capital and liquidity. Shares are initially intended for institutional investors, including stablecoin


issuers and digital asset


infrastructure providers.


Invesco believes the next phase of investing growth will be driven by the convergence of traditional asset management and onchain infrastructure. The most significant opportunities lie in expanding institutional access, improving capital efficiency, and enabling new utility for investment assets. IROXX brings those capabilities together through blockchain-enabled infrastructure, support for transactions in both U.S. dollars and USDC, and an onchain representation of reserve assets designed for an increasingly digital financial system.


IROXX is managed by Invesco's Global Liquidity team, one of the firm's longest-standing investment capabilities. For more than 45 years, Global Liquidity has managed cash and short-duration strategies through multiple market cycles, credit events and interest-rate environments. As of September 30, 2026, the team managed approximately $261.6 billion in assets including Treasury and Treasury-backed repurchase agreement exposures.


"The requirements of stablecoin


reserve management closely align with the core principles that have guided our liquidity business for decades: preservation of capital, access to liquidity and disciplined risk management," said Laurie Brignac, Head of Global Liquidity at Invesco. "As onchain markets mature, we see increasing demand for high-quality, transparent reserve assets managed with the same rigor investors expect from institutional cash management solutions. IROXX brings our liquidity expertise into an emerging segment of the market while maintaining the investment discipline that has defined the platform for more than four decades."


The launch marks an expansion of Invesco's partnership with Superstate, building on Invesco's role as investment manager of[Invesco Short Duration US Government Securities Fund](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824167-1&h=1475395923&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.invesco.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Finstitutional%2Fstrategies%2Fmoney-market-and-liquidity%2Fustb.html&a=Invesco+Short+Duration+US+Government+Securities+Fund) (USTB)1. Through the Invesco Stablecoin


Reserves Onchain Fund, Superstate provides blockchain-integrated transfer agency and recordkeeping technology designed to support onchain ownership and transactions while maintaining the regulatory standards of a registered investment fund. It is the first publicly registered fund to launch using Superstate's FundOS platform, extending the infrastructure from private placements to registered funds.


"By combining Invesco's more than four decades of institutional liquidity management expertise with Superstate's tokenization


infrastructure, IROXX brings institutional-grade reserve management and onchain transparency together in a single product. Stablecoin


issuers can now hold professionally managed reserves while providing verifiable proof of those reserves directly onchain," said Robert Leshner, Superstate CEO.


1: The Invesco Short Duration US Government Securities Fund (USTB) is available to Accredited Investors and Qualified Purchasers only. This is not an offer to buy any investment. An offer can only be made by the confidential private placement memorandum.


**About Invesco Ltd.** Invesco Ltd. is one of the world's leading asset management firms serving clients in more than 120 countries. With US$2.5 trillion in assets under management as of September 30, 2026, we deliver a comprehensive range of investment capabilities across public, private, active, and passive. Our collaborative mindset, breadth of solutions and global scale mean we're well positioned to help retail and institutional investors rethink challenges and find new possibilities for success. For more information, visit[www.invesco.com](http://www.invesco.com/) .


Invesco Distributors, Inc. is the U.S. distributor for Invesco Ltd.'s products and is a wholly owned, indirect subsidiary of Invesco Ltd.


**About Superstate** Superstate moves securities onchain and puts them to work. Our tokenization


infrastructure lets asset managers and companies bring funds and equities onchain compliantly, with ownership, eligibility, and recordkeeping built in, and reach new investors through onchain distribution. The result is institutional-grade assets, backed by Superstate's SEC-registered digital transfer agency, that eligible investors can hold directly or access through the exchanges, wallets, neobanks, vaults, and onchain financial protocols that integrate them. Learn more at superstate.com.


**About Risks** **You could lose money by investing in the Fund. Although the Fund seeks to preserve your investment at $1.00 per share, it cannot guarantee it will do so. An investment in the Fund is not a bank account and is not insured or guaranteed by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation or any other government agency. The Fund's sponsor is not required to reimburse the Fund for losses, and you should not expect that the sponsor will provide financial support to the Fund at any time, including during periods of market stress.**


**The Fund does not invest in stablecoins or in stablecoin issuers.**


The Fund expects stablecoin


issuers to hold a significant portion of its shares as reserve assets. Stablecoin


market volatility, issuer-specific events, changes in redemption activity, or legal and regulatory developments may cause rapid or substantial Fund purchases or redemptions, which could adversely affect the Fund's liquidity, yield, expenses, remaining shareholders, and ability to maintain a stable share price. The Fund's limited universe of eligible reserve assets may also result in a lower yield than other money market funds, and evolving stablecoin


regulation may require changes to the Fund's investments or operations.


Large purchases or redemptions may adversely affect the Fund's liquidity, yield, expense ratio and net asset value, increase transaction costs, and negatively impact remaining shareholders. This risk may be heightened if multiple stablecoin


issuers redeem Fund shares at the same time.


The Fund's yield will vary as the short-term securities in its portfolio mature or are sold and the proceeds are reinvested in other securities. Additionally, inflation may outpace and diminish investment returns over time.


The investment techniques and risk analysis used by the portfolio managers may not produce the desired results.


The Fund's use of blockchain technology is subject to operational, technological and cybersecurity risks, including network outages or congestion, transaction delays or increased fees, coding or cryptographic flaws, cyberattacks, compromised digital wallets, unauthorized transfers, and network modifications or forks. These events could disrupt or incorrectly record transactions, delay or prevent access to tokenized Fund shares, and result in the loss of some or all of an investment. Because the Fund is new, there is limited operating history on which to evaluate these risks.


Decentralized


blockchain networks rely on evolving governance processes that may lack consensus or clarity. Changes in network protocols or applicable laws, regulations or regulatory interpretations could impair network functionality; delay, restrict or prevent transactions in Fund shares; require changes to the Fund's operations; or otherwise adversely affect the Fund and its shareholders.


Transactions in tokenized Fund shares, including redemptions and peer-to-peer transfers, require payment of variable blockchain transaction fees known as "gas" in the applicable network's native digital asset


. Gas prices and processing times may fluctuate significantly based on network congestion, transaction complexity, demand and the fee selected by a shareholder, and the Fund cannot control these conditions. Higher gas prices may increase shareholder costs, while an inadequate gas fee, insufficient wallet


assets, network or wallet


disruptions, or smart-contract errors could delay, reject, incorrectly process or prevent a transaction and may result in excessive or unintended gas usage. A redemption initiated before the Fund's cutoff time may therefore be received in good order after the cutoff, delaying proceeds and leaving the shareholder exposed to changes in the value of Fund shares until the Fund next calculates its net asset value. Because the Fund is new, there is limited operating history regarding these transaction risks.


The Fund relies on a blockchain-integrated sub-transfer agent recordkeeping system and Investor Portal that are subject to operational, technological, recordkeeping and cybersecurity risks. System flaws, outages, integration errors, technological changes, inaccurate or incomplete investor information, or compromised credentials could impair Investor Portal access; delay, prevent or incorrectly record transactions; affect investor eligibility or regulatory determinations; or permit unauthorized activity. Participants are responsible for maintaining accurate information and restricting access to authorized persons. Unauthorized or erroneous actions may not be detected or disputed promptly, may not be reversible, and could result in inaccurate ownership records, loss of access to Fund shares, financial loss, or other adverse effects on the Fund and its shareholders.


There are a limited number of funds that maintain shares in the form of digital securities. Given the novel nature of this product, the Fund, Adviser, Transfer Agent, Sub-Transfer Agent and other service providers have relatively limited experience using blockchain technology to maintain records and facilitate transactions in the interests of digital securities of a registered fund. Accordingly, there may be an increased risk of errors or unauthorized transactions involving Fund shares. Any such errors or unauthorized transactions could adversely affect the Fund.
